question: Where was the 36th National Games of India held in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Games**:-

 
 
• The **National Games** is a biennial multi-sport event that features athletes from all over India.
 
• The event is organized by the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** and is considered to be one of the biggest sporting events in the country. 
 
• The **36th National Games** were held in **Gujarat **from **29th Sep 2022** to **12th Oct 2022**.
